title: Count how many of a mixed list of variables are quantitative
source: S1 Ch1 theory S1-1.1 Quick check 1 (2 quantitative out of 4 named variables)
stem: A list of {n|int} variables consists of {q|int} qualitative, {d|int} discrete and {c|int} continuous variables. How many of these {n|int} variables are quantitative?

steps.name: form
steps.text_tex: The {d|int} discrete counts and the {c|int} continuous measurements are quantitative, and the {q|int} qualitative categories are not.

contexts.stem: In a survey, {n|int} variables are recorded: {q|int} are word-based categories, {d|int} are counts and {c|int} are measured lengths. How many of these {n|int} variables are quantitative?
A laboratory records {n|int} variables: {q|int} colour labels, {d|int} item counts and {c|int} temperatures. How many of these {n|int} variables are quantitative?

title: Count how many of a mixed list of quantitative variables are discrete
source: S1 Ch1 theory S1-1.1 Quick check 2 (2 discrete out of 4 variables)
stem: A list of {n|int} quantitative variables consists of {d|int} discrete variables and {c|int} continuous variables. How many of these {n|int} variables are discrete?

steps.name: form
steps.text_tex: The {d|int} counts are discrete and the {c|int} measurements are continuous.

contexts.stem: A sports club records {n|int} quantitative variables: {d|int} are scores counted in whole numbers and {c|int} are timed measurements. How many of these {n|int} variables are discrete?
A shop records {n|int} quantitative variables: {d|int} are stock counts and {c|int} are measured masses. How many of these {n|int} variables are discrete?

title: Count how many recorded values in a mixed list are quantitative
source: S1 Ch1 theory S1-1.1 Quick check 3 (5 colours, 4 door-counts, 3 lengths, 7 quantitative)
stem: A list of {n|int} recorded values consists of {a|int} car colours, {b|int} counts of the number of doors and {c|int} lengths in metres. How many of these {n|int} recorded values are quantitative?

steps.name: form
steps.text_tex: The {a|int} colours are qualitative. The {b|int} door-counts and the {c|int} lengths are quantitative.

contexts.stem: A list of {n|int} recorded values consists of {a|int} fabric colours, {b|int} counts of the number of pockets and {c|int} sleeve lengths in centimetres. How many of these {n|int} recorded values are quantitative?

A list of {n|int} recorded values consists of {a|int} book genres, {b|int} counts of the number of chapters and {c|int} page-widths in millimetres. How many of these {n|int} recorded values are quantitative?
